scope: Stage-2 authority and repository transfer, exact pinned tree, README, license, citation, manifests, testing documentation and bundled MNIST demonstration inspected statically. No environment, test, dataset download or model training was executed.

unresolved_findings.finding: No Atlas-paper relationship is asserted for this general-purpose supporting framework.
Backend requirements specify minimums or ranges rather than a complete immutable environment lock.
The representative MNIST example does not select a backend, report a seed or constrain deterministic execution.
MNIST is runtime-loaded and no dataset archive checksum is bundled with the representative example.
The example provides no immutable expected metric threshold, and neither the multi-backend test matrix nor example was executed.

notes: The verified repository transfer is preserved without changing CR identity.
